issue_summary_neutral: Following 2020 amendments to Section 12 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (applicable to Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks from June 2020), RBI issued a draft circular in July 2021 proposing a framework for issue and regulation of share capital and securities by UCBs. The draft also asked stakeholders whether a similar framework should be extended to State Co-operative Banks and District Central Co-operative Banks, for which the amended Act provisions took effect from April 2021. Comments were invited by August 31, 2021.
neutral_title: RBI draft: share capital and securities framework for Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks
notes: Systematic sample position 1/26 (interval k=1.18, start=0.59); not dropped.

issue_summary_neutral: In August 2021 RBI placed on its website two draft documents proposing to rationalise the regulatory framework governing overseas investment and acquisition of immovable property abroad by Indian residents: draft Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments - Overseas Investment) Rules, 2021 and draft Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) Regulations, 2021. The stated aim was to liberalise the existing framework (dated 2004/2016) and promote ease of doing business. Comments were invited within a two-week window, by August 23, 2021.
neutral_title: RBI draft: rationalisation of overseas investment rules under FEMA

issue_summary_neutral: In October 2021 RBI released a draft Master Direction proposing to implement the Basel III capital framework for the four All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) - EXIM Bank, NABARD, NHB and SIDBI - and to consolidate existing instructions on exposure norms, classification/valuation/operation of investment portfolios, and resource-raising norms for these institutions, along with new limits on AIFI investments in subsidiaries and financial/non-financial services companies. Comments were invited by November 30, 2021.
neutral_title: RBI draft: Basel III prudential framework for All India Financial Institutions

issue_summary_neutral: In December 2021, as part of convergence of RBI's bank regulations with Basel III standards, RBI placed a draft Master Direction on Minimum Capital Requirements for Operational Risk on its website, applicable to all Commercial Banks except Local Area Banks, Payments Banks, Regional Rural Banks and Small Finance Banks. Comments from stakeholders and the public were invited by January 31, 2022.
neutral_title: RBI draft: minimum capital requirements for operational risk (Basel III convergence)

issue_summary_neutral: In April 2022 RBI placed draft guidelines on its website for 'Processing and Settlement of Small Value Export and Import related payments' facilitated by Online Export-Import Facilitators (OEIF, formerly OPGSP), proposing to simplify and rationalise the 2010/2013/2015-vintage rules governing settlement of such payments in light of growth in e-commerce. Comments were invited by April 24, 2022.
neutral_title: RBI draft: settlement of small-value export/import payments via Online Export-Import Facilitators

issue_summary_neutral: In June 2022 RBI placed on its website Draft Reserve Bank of India (Margining for Non-Centrally Cleared OTC Derivatives) Directions, 2022, covering exchange of initial margin for non-centrally cleared OTC derivatives (NCCDs), following G-20 recommendations. The draft built on the Variation Margin Master Direction already issued in June 2022, and consolidated provisions for both variation and initial margin, with the initial-margin provisions highlighted as the subject of the new consultation. Comments were invited from banks, market participants and other interested parties by July 29, 2022.
neutral_title: RBI draft: initial margin directions for non-centrally cleared OTC derivatives

issue_summary_neutral: Following an announcement in the February 2022 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies that guidelines on Information Technology Governance and Controls, Business Continuity Management and Information Systems Audit needed updating and consolidation, RBI released a draft Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices in October 2022. Comments were invited from regulated entities and other stakeholders by November 20, 2022.
neutral_title: RBI draft: IT governance, risk, controls and assurance practices master direction

issue_summary_neutral: Following the same February 2022 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies that flagged a need to update IT-outsourcing risk guidance, RBI released a draft Master Direction on Outsourcing of Information Technology (IT) Services in June 2022, covering risk-management framework for IT/ITeS outsourcing, concentration-risk management, periodic risk assessment and outsourcing to foreign service providers. Comments were invited by July 22, 2022.
neutral_title: RBI draft: master direction on outsourcing of IT services

issue_summary_neutral: In February 2023, as part of convergence with Basel III standards, RBI released draft Guidelines for Minimum Capital Requirements for Market Risk, applicable to all Commercial Banks except Local Area Banks, Payments Banks, Regional Rural Banks and Small Finance Banks, and explicitly not applicable to co-operative banks. The draft proposed an effective date of April 1, 2024. Comments were invited by April 15, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: minimum capital requirements for market risk (Basel III)

issue_summary_neutral: Also on February 17, 2023 -- in pursuance of an announcement in the February 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies -- RBI released Draft Reserve Bank of India (Government Securities Lending) Directions, 2023, proposing to permit lending and borrowing of Government securities to augment the existing 'special repo' market and support wider participation in securities lending. Comments were invited by March 17, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: government securities lending and borrowing directions

issue_summary_neutral: In pursuance of the February 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI released a Draft Circular on Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts in April 2023, reviewing supervisory findings of divergent and sometimes excessive penal-interest practices among regulated entities and proposing that any penalty for loan default or non-compliance take the form of transparent 'penal charges' rather than 'penal interest' added to the contracted rate, with no capitalisation of such charges. Comments were invited by May 15, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: fair lending practice on penal charges in loan accounts

issue_summary_neutral: In July 2023 RBI released a draft circular on Arrangements with Card Networks for issue of Debit, Credit and Prepaid Cards, proposing to require card issuers (banks and non-banks) to offer cards on more than one card network and to give customers a choice among available networks, while barring issuers from agreements that restrict tie-ups with other card networks. Comments were invited by August 4, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: arrangements with card networks for debit, credit and prepaid cards

issue_summary_neutral: In September 2023 RBI released a Draft Master Direction on Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters, revising the 1999-origin wilful-defaulter scheme (last consolidated in a 2015 Master Circular) after review of court judgments and stakeholder representations. The draft proposed to expand which regulated entities can classify borrowers as wilful defaulters, broaden the definition of wilful default, refine identification processes, require review/finalisation within six months of NPA classification, and address treatment of wilful-default loans sold to Asset Reconstruction Companies under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. Comments were invited by October 31, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: treatment of wilful defaulters and large defaulters master direction

issue_summary_neutral: Following an announcement in the August 5, 2022 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI released a draft Master Direction on Managing Risks and Code of Conduct in Outsourcing of Financial Services in October 2023, aiming to incorporate, update and harmonise extant outsourcing directions/guidelines/instructions into a single reference document for regulated entities. Comments were invited by November 28, 2023.
neutral_title: RBI draft: managing risks and code of conduct in outsourcing of financial services

issue_summary_neutral: As announced in the June 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI placed a draft rationalised and simplified licensing framework for Authorised Persons (APs) under FEMA, 1999 on its website in December 2023, updating a framework last reviewed in March 2006, citing progressive liberalisation, digitisation of payment systems and evolving institutional structures. Comments were invited by January 31, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: rationalised licensing framework for Authorised Persons under FEMA

issue_summary_neutral: In December 2023 RBI released Draft Reserve Bank of India (Bond Forwards) Directions, 2023, proposing to permit forward contracts to deliver government securities, expanding the suite of interest-rate derivative products available so that market participants -- especially long-term investors -- can better manage cash flows and interest-rate risk. Comments were invited by January 25, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: bond forwards directions for government securities

issue_summary_neutral: In January 2024 RBI placed a Draft Circular on Credit/Investment Concentration Norms for Government-owned NBFCs on its website, applicable to all government-owned NBFCs registered with RBI. Comments were invited by February 29, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: credit/investment concentration norms for government-owned NBFCs

issue_summary_neutral: In January 2024 RBI released a draft circular on Review of Regulatory Framework for Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) and Harmonisation of Regulations Applicable to HFCs and NBFCs, following up on a 2020 circular that had flagged phased harmonisation. The draft proposed to align deposit directions for deposit-taking HFCs, derivative participation for hedging, diversification into other financial products, and Account Aggregator technical specifications with NBFC norms, and also proposed to review certain deposit-taking-NBFC directions. Comments were invited by February 29, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: harmonisation of Housing Finance Company and NBFC regulations

issue_summary_neutral: Following an announcement in the February 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI placed draft guidelines on a Disclosure Framework on Climate-related Financial Risks, 2024 on its website in February 2024, applicable to Scheduled Commercial Banks, Tier-IV UCBs, All-India Financial Institutions and Top/Upper Layer NBFCs. Comments were invited by April 30, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: disclosure framework on climate-related financial risks

issue_summary_neutral: In April 2024 RBI placed two draft directions on regulation of Payment Aggregators (PAs) on its website: new draft directions extending regulation to physical/offline point-of-sale PAs (following an announcement in the September 30, 2022 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies), and proposed amendments to the existing online-PA directions covering KYC/due-diligence of merchants and escrow-account operations. Comments were invited by May 31, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: regulation of Payment Aggregators (physical point-of-sale and updated directions)

issue_summary_neutral: In pursuance of the December 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI placed a Draft Circular on Digital Lending - Transparency in Aggregation of Loan Products from Multiple Lenders on its website in April 2024, addressing web-aggregation of loan products by Lending Service Providers (LSPs). Comments were invited by May 31, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: transparency in aggregation of loan products by digital lending service providers

issue_summary_neutral: In pursuance of the February 8, 2024 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI placed a Draft Master Direction - Reserve Bank of India (Electronic Trading Platforms) Directions, 2024 on its website in April 2024, reviewing the October-2018 regulatory framework for Electronic Trading Platforms (ETPs) executing transactions in RBI-regulated financial instruments. Comments were invited from ETP operators, banks, market participants and other interested parties by May 31, 2024.
neutral_title: RBI draft: Electronic Trading Platforms master direction (review)

issue_summary_neutral: In pursuance of the December 8, 2023 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies (which had flagged a unified regulatory framework on connected lending), RBI issued a draft regulatory framework on lending to related parties in October 2025, spanning eight separate Directions across Commercial Banks, SFBs, RRBs, LABs, UCBs, RCBs, NBFCs and AIFIs. The draft proposes scale-based materiality thresholds requiring board/committee approval, exclusion of independent directors of other banks from the 'related persons' definition, a principle-based exemption from Section 20(1)(b) of the Banking Regulation Act for certain loan types, and enhanced supervisory reporting/disclosure. Comments were invited by October 31, 2025.
neutral_title: RBI draft: harmonised framework on lending to related parties

issue_summary_neutral: In October 2025 RBI released the draft Reserve Bank - Ombudsman Scheme, 2025, a comprehensive review of the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), 2021, which had launched on November 12, 2021 to give customers of Regulated Entities a speedy, cost-effective and expeditious alternate grievance-redress mechanism. Comments were invited from the public and stakeholders by October 28, 2025.
neutral_title: RBI draft: revised Reserve Bank - Ombudsman Scheme, 2025

issue_summary_neutral: In December 2025 RBI released a Draft Circular on Disclosure of Transaction Cost for Foreign Exchange Transactions, building on a January 2024 mandate that Authorised Dealers disclose mid-market mark/bid-ask prices for forex derivative contracts to retail users. The new draft proposes to further mandate disclosure of transaction cost (remittance fees, exchange rate, currency conversion charges) for forex cash, tom and spot contracts offered to retail users. Comments were invited by January 9, 2026.
neutral_title: RBI draft: disclosure of transaction cost for foreign exchange transactions

issue_summary_neutral: In January 2026 RBI released draft Amendment Directions revising Net Open Position (NOP) computation instructions across eight RE categories, covering the methodology for calculating capital charge on foreign exchange risk under the FMRD Master Direction and the Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy Directions, 2025. Proposed changes include removing separate offshore/onshore NOP calculation, including accumulated overseas-operations surplus in NOP, calculating forex risk capital charge on actual NOP, aligning the Shorthand method with Basel guidelines (treating gold separately), and exempting certain structural forex positions. Comments were invited by February 3, 2026.
neutral_title: RBI draft: revised Net Open Position instructions for foreign exchange risk capital

issue_summary_neutral: Following an announcement in the February 6, 2026 Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies, RBI released draft Amendment Directions in February 2026 proposing to exempt eligible NBFCs that neither avail public funds nor have customer interface (including 'Type I NBFCs' with asset size up to Rs. 1,000 crore) from RBI registration requirements, subject to specified conditions, along with a deregistration/conversion procedure for existing such NBFCs. FAQs accompanied the draft. Comments were invited till March 4, 2026.
neutral_title: RBI draft: registration exemption for low-risk NBFCs under scale-based regulation
